scope: 330 authored observations in 110 directions; sentences frozen before runtime capture. Concept selection informed by existing packs; not blind, human conversation, or population coverage. Three concepts alone cannot establish release quality.
requirements: Use actual bundled default without injected lookup.
Run automatic source detection and direct configured-pair lookup separately.
Capture source detection, abstention reason, emitted source/target/reading, concept/output ID, and translation/readiness call counts.
Every emitted non-Latin target needs a usable Latin reading; Latin targets may use their original Latin spelling.
For each target language, synthesize one actually emitted word with selected engine/voice/locale and output duration; eligibility alone is not acoustic validation.
Retain same-script and non-Roman source detection abstentions rather than overriding them silently.
